name: Top Bar UI
description: UI interaction spec for the custom menu bar with hover-based dropdown menus and theme toggle.

dom.container: #menu-bar (matches #titlebar height, flex row, Space Mono 11px, user-select:none, -webkit-app-region:drag)
structure: .menu-dropdown (position:absolute, left:0, top:100%, min-width:180px, border:1px dashed var(--border), border-radius:8px, background:var(--surface), box-shadow:var(--shadow), z-index:1000)
.menu-dropdown-nested (position:absolute, left:100%, top:0, min-width:180px, border:1px dashed var(--border))
.menu-check (checkmark ✓ for selected state, e.g. grid style, zoom lock)

interactions.name: menu_hover_open
interactions.gesture: Cancel any pending close timer, close all open menus, add .open class to hovered menu item (shows dropdown)

interactions.name: menu_hover_close
interactions.gesture: Start 300ms close timer. Timer cancelled if mouse re-enters dropdown.

interactions.name: nested_hover_open
interactions.gesture: Nested dropdown appears to right (left:100%) with ▸ arrow indicator

interactions.name: click_outside
interactions.trigger: Click anywhere on document (not on menu)
interactions.gesture: Close all open menus. Handler re-registered on each render.

interactions.name: menu_item_click
interactions.gesture: Fire corresponding callback, close all menus. Click handler stops propagation.

examples.View > Terminal > {instance}: onFocusTerminal(uuid) or onReopenTerminal(uuid) based on isOpen

states.default: All menus closed, menu items at default styling
states.menu_open: .menu-item has .open class, dropdown visible, 300ms auto-close timer active
states.nested_open: .menu-item-nested shows nested dropdown alongside parent dropdown

dynamic_content.terminal_submenu: Generated from termItems[] — shows 'New' + separator + instance list (dimmed if closed)
dynamic_content.explorer_submenu: Generated from explorerItems[] — shows 'New' + separator + instance list
dynamic_content.markdown_submenu: Generated from mdItems[] — shows 'New' + separator + instance list
dynamic_content.grid_submenu: Shows check mark next to active style (dots/grid/none)
dynamic_content.zoom_lock: Shows check mark when zoom is locked
